body.name: Graph-selected certified one-shot procedure
body.construction: First compare \(M_n\) with \(n\).  If \(M_n\ge n\), form none of \(\pi_i(G)\), \(Q_G\), \(w_i(z;G)\), or \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\); assign \(Z=\mathbf 1_n\), report \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{cert}}=n^{-1}\sum_{i\in V_n}y_i(\mathbf 1_n)\), and set \(\overline U(G)=1\).  If \(M_n<n\), compute the two candidates and graph-only scores from Definition~\(\mathrm{def{:}seed\mbox{-}design}\), and use their smaller certificate minimizer \(k_n\).  Compute \(U(G,k_n)\).  When \(U(G,k_n)\le1\), use \(Z^{\mathrm{seed}}\), report \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{cert}}=\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\), and set \(\overline U(G)=U(G,k_n)\); otherwise return the same all-treated fallback and set \(\overline U(G)=1\).
